changelog:
Initial release of Alibaba Cloud KVStore Health Inspection skill.

- Provides automated health inspection and reporting for Alibaba Cloud Redis (ApsaraDB for Redis / Tair) instances.
- Generates HTML reports across 7 key areas: instance info, sessions, resource usage, big/hot key analysis, slow logs, alert history, and recommendations.
- Supports single-instance, multi-instance, and full-account batch inspection modes.
- Supports standard, cluster, SplitRW architectures, including Tair PENA (persistent memory) and ESSD (disk) types.
- Strictly requires all inspections to be executed via the provided Python script; direct aliyun CLI data collection is disallowed.
- Includes hard rules for execution and clear mapping from user intent to script parameters for streamlined usage.
